definitions.explanation: A person who dives — scuba diver, competitive (springboard/platform) diver, or skydiver. Context determines which kind.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はダイバーだ。
{経験豊富|けいけんほうふ}なダイバーが{深海|しんかい}を{調査|ちょうさ}した。
examples.english: An experienced diver surveyed the deep sea.

examples.japanese: {大会|たいかい}に{出場|しゅつじょう}するダイバーは、{毎日|まいにち}{何|なん}{時間|じかん}も{練習|れんしゅう}を{重|かさ}ねる。
examples.english: Divers competing in tournaments put in many hours of practice every day.

notes:
From English "diver." Most commonly refers to a scuba diver in casual speech. Compounds clarify the type when needed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スキューバダイバー: scuba diver
- スカイダイバー: skydiver
- {素潜|すもぐ}りダイバー: free diver
- ベテランダイバー: veteran diver
- ダイバーズウォッチ: diver's watch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {潜水士|せんすいし}: a licensed/professional diver (occupation, formal)
- {海女|あま}: female free-diver who harvests shellfish or pearls (traditional Japanese occupation)
